title: CozyBlocks
description: Cozy Create adventures: Build, chill & explore.
body:
🧱 **CozyBlocks: Your Tranquil Engineering Adventure**
Welcome to **CozyBlocks**! This modpack is carefully crafted for players who love the mechanical depth of engineering but want to experience it within a warm, atmospheric, and stress-free world. Forget the grind and the chaos of typical survival; in CozyBlocks, it’s all about building at your own pace, aesthetics, and pure creativity.

✨ **Why Choose CozyBlocks?**
⚙️ **Mechanical Perfection:** With the Create mod at its heart, you can design beautiful, moving factories that blend seamlessly into the environment. No futuristic magic blocks—just gears, shafts, and steam power!

🌌 **Atmospheric Skies:** Thanks to FabricSkyBoxes and OptiBoxes, you’ll enjoy breathtaking starry nights and immersive weather effects that make every evening special.

🛠️ **Refined Aesthetics:** Featuring mods like Continuity, your textures and glass blocks will look smoother than ever, providing that clean, modern "cozy" look.

🌍 **Peaceful Exploration:** The world is optimized for a buttery-smooth experience, allowing you to wander through biomes undisturbed while searching for the perfect spot for your next build.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: RAM Settings**
For a smooth experience without stutters, it is required to manually increase the allocated memory in your launcher.

**Minimum required: 8GB RAM**

**Recommended: 8GB - 10GB RAM**

📜 **Credits**
A special thank you to all the mod developers whose hard work makes CozyBlocks possible. You can find the full list of mods under the 'Dependencies' tab.
